title: Nanobubbles in graphene oxide synthesis: investigation of structure and physicochemical properties with boosting of oxygen content and microporous surface area
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16525-16531
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02336J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Konstantinos N. Maroulas, Nick Vordos, Athanasios C. Mitropoulos, George Z. Kyzas
This research article focuses on the effect of nanobubbles’ presence during graphene oxide synthesis. Extensive characterisation verified the enhanced structural properties and the increased oxygen content, compared to the traditional synthesis.
